executiveSummary: Overall OT Cyber Threat Level: CRITICAL U.S. government advisories confirm active exploitation of industrial PLCs: Iranian-linked actors altered logic and HMI alarms across Water/Wastewater and Energy; defenders must immediately remove internet exposure, validate logic integrity, and enforce MFA on OT remote access. Security Advisory Separate advisory warns of active targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs using S7comm (TCP/102) with AI-assisted tooling for reconnaissance and write operations; block TCP/102 at perimeters, harden access controls, and baseline S7 traffic. Security Advisory Pro-Russia hacktivists are opportunistically abusing exposed VNC to access/deface HMIs, suppress alarms, and change setpoints, causing real operational impacts; immediately remove public VNC and broker remote access via MFA-protected jump hosts. Security Advisory MikroTik RouterOS pre-auth flaws are being widely exploited ("MikroTrick"); patch to 6.49.21/7.23.4+/7.24.2+/7.25beta3, restrict SSH/WebFig/Winbox to management networks, and hunt for rogue users/scripts. Supporting Report CISA KEV Multiple OT-adjacent product risks: Danfoss iC7 variable-frequency drives accept unsigned apps/firmware; EVbee DC-80 EVSE expose unauthenticated OCPP/WebSocket RCE; Eclipse Milo (OPC UA) server flaws enable unauthorized method calls and DoS-segmentation, strict allow-listing, and urgent patching are required. View Article View Article Critical perimeter and DevOps compromises elevate IT-to-OT pivot risk: actively exploited GitLab arbitrary file-read (CVE-2026-85706), Gitea RCE used by a China-nexus group to steal industrial automation code, and NetScaler SAML pre-auth RCE with public PoC-patch, rotate secrets, and audit for pre-patch compromise. View Article View Article Red team assessments show WWS and government networks at high risk from identity and AD misconfigurations that could bridge into OT DMZs; prioritize MFA everywhere, ADCS hardening (ESC1), token revocation, and strict IT/OT segmentation. Security Advisory Confirmed OT-Targeting CSAs 3+ PLCs, HMIs, VNC Actively Exploited Edge/VPN/Router CVEs 6+ MikroTik, NetScaler, Cisco SEG High-Risk OT/IIoT Product Families 5+ VFDs, EVSE, OPC UA libs, Cameras Priority Patch Windows (Next 72h) Critical Routers, NetScaler, DevOps

relevance: Why this matters now Multiple concurrent, government-attributed operations are directly manipulating PLC logic and HMI states. Edge devices (routers/VPNs/gateways) and DevOps platforms (GitLab/Gitea) are being exploited to seed pivots into OT environments. Core industrial protocols and components (S7comm/OPC UA/VFDs/EVSE) are affected-this increases risk of loss of view/control. Immediate exposure indicators Any PLC or HMI reachable from the internet; open TCP/102 (S7comm), 44818/2222 (CIP), 5900-5910 (VNC). Unpatched MikroTik/NetScaler/Cisco SEG at perimeters; AD/IDP without phishing-resistant MFA. Unsegmented EV chargers, drives, cameras, satcom terminals sharing routes with OT controls.

outlook72h: Priority patching & hunts: MikroTik fleets; NetScaler RCE PoC exposure; GitLab file-read abuse; perimeter routers for SNMP/TFTP patterns. Immediate isolation checks: confirm no direct internet routes to PLCs/HMIs; disable VNC where present; close S7comm at perimeter. Deploy detections: S7comm write/PUT/GET anomalies; webshell paths on NetScaler; rogue MikroTik users/schedulers; OneDrive/MEGA exfil on servers. Vendor maintenance windows: coordinate Danfoss iC7, EVSE, OPC UA server updates; validate signed firmware & configs post-update.
